commands.availability: available on Linux with FUSE and on macOS with macFUSE

flags.name: --root
flags.description: Store node chunks below this directory.

flags.name: --listen
flags.description: Select the node-store service listener.

flags.name: --control-listen
flags.description: Select the node-store control listener.

flags.name: --budget-bytes
flags.description: Set the node-cache byte budget.

flags.name: --control
flags.description: Select the node-store control endpoint.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Write stable JSON instead of text.

flags.name: --socket
flags.description: Select the mount socket path.

flags.name: --store
flags.description: Select the node chunk store endpoint.

commands.exit_status: 0 on success, 1 on an operation failure, and 2 for invalid usage.
